package.description: Assemble a team of AI agents that grows together

en-US.description: Assemble a team of AI agents that grows together
en-US.longDescription:
Rovai AI is like an Agent guild of your own, where you can recruit members with different personalities and roles.
Together, they explore, discuss, and act on real tasks — building
team chemistry and collaborative memory along the way.

Core Capabilities

| Core capability                   | What it means in Rovai                                                                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Long-lived members                | Preserve each member's enduring identity, appearance, responsibilities, and working style so they can rejoin the team across Camps and Tasks.                                    |
| Camp collaboration                | Organize shared conversations, long-lived members, Tasks, attachments, and execution state around one objective, reducing the context users must carry between separate windows. |
| Role-based collaboration          | Turn paired questioning, document-informed decision-making, code review, and group discussion into repeatable ways for a team to work together.                                  |
| Tasks and ownership               | Give ongoing work a title, owner, and state so unfinished work remains trackable and can be picked up by another member.                                                         |
| Member handoffs                   | Use @mentions, the default Lead, direct replies, and A2A routing to pass questions, conclusions, and next actions to the right member.                                           |
| Visible execution                 | Inspect tool calls, process state, intermediate results, and final delivery in an independent execution console instead of hiding real work behind a single completion message.  |
| Approvals, evidence, and recovery | Require explicit approval for important actions, preserve reviewable execution evidence, and continue from existing state after interruption.                                    |
| Collaborative memory              | Preserve important decisions, lessons, and team habits so members gradually understand how this team has solved problems together.                                               |
| Native capability compatibility   | Use a generic ACP Adapter to connect Agent Runtimes that support ACP while preserving their native models, permissions, Skills, MCP, and session capabilities whenever possible. |

These capabilities are not isolated features. They are connected by one collaboration architecture:
src="docs/assets/readme/rovai-architecture.png"
alt="Rovai AI architecture showing the Principal, Desktop, Core, Runtime Adapter Layer, Agent Runtimes, user workspace, and Runtime-native capabilities"
en-US.name: Rovai AI
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release adds full conversation export, reduces the amount of history scanned when opening or switching conversations, and fixes how execution status and Agent completion are reported.
Thanks to @caoshuisi for reporting Pi runs being marked as failed after completion and unclear CodeBuddy errors in Issue #1012.
- [Feature] Export a full conversation from the sidebar. Choose “Export thread” from the conversation menu to preview and save the conversation as HTML, PNG, or Markdown without scrolling back to load older messages. To export an excerpt, select multiple messages. The text-selection toolbar now offers only quoting.
- [UI] Improve export preview on phones. Long-press a conversation to open the export menu. The HTML preview fits the screen width, and the buttons are easier to tap.
- [Performance] Scan less unrelated history when opening or switching conversations. Run counts, run lists, and file changes are read for the current conversation. Some older run cards and their file changes are removed from these lists. Messages and original records are retained in the database.
- [Fix] Show the latest run status after retrying. After a failed or manually stopped run is retried, the message receipt follows the new attempt and “View run” opens it. Receipts no longer show “Pending” when there is no delivery or run record.
- [Fix] Recognize successful runs without a final text reply. When Pi, Codex, Antigravity, or a supported ACP Agent reports success, the run can complete without a final chat message.
- [Fix] Show the error details returned by CodeBuddy. When a model request fails, the run card shows available details, such as an authentication error or invalid request parameters.
- [UX] Show the first page of conversations when a group is reopened. Regular projects, pinned projects, and Quick Chat initially show five unpinned conversations. Use “Show more” to load additional entries.

zh-CN.description: 组建一支会一起成长的 Agent 队伍
zh-CN.longDescription:
Rovai AI 像一座属于你的 Agent 公会，你可以招募不同性格与分工的队员。他们围绕真实任务共同探索、讨论与行动，并在一次次旅程中逐渐形成属于这支队伍的默契与协作记忆。

核心能力

| 核心能力         | 在 Rovai 中意味着什么                                                                                 |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 长期队员         | 为队员保留持续存在的身份、形象、职责和协作方式，让他们在不同 Camp 与任务中再次归队。                  |
| Camp 协作        | 将共享会话、长期队员、Task、附件与执行状态组织在同一个目标下，减少用户来回搬运上下文。                |
| 角色化协作       | 把双人追问、文档决策、代码评审和集体讨论组织成可以反复使用的团队协作方式。                            |
| Task 与责任      | 为需要推进的工作明确标题、负责人和状态，让未完成事项能够被持续追踪和接手。                            |
| 队员间交接       | 通过 @mention、默认 Lead、直接回复和 A2A 路由，把问题、结论与后续行动交给合适的队员。                 |
| 可见执行         | 在独立执行台中查看工具调用、过程状态、中间结果和最终交付，不让真实工作隐藏在一句完成通知之后。        |
| 权限、证据与恢复 | 重要操作经过明确审批，执行过程留下可复核证据，任务中断后可以根据已有状态继续。                        |
| 协作记忆         | 沉淀重要决定、经验与团队习惯，让队员逐渐理解这支队伍过去如何共同解决问题。                            |
| 原生能力兼容     | 通过通用 ACP Adapter 接入支持 ACP 的 Agent Runtime，尽量保留其原生模型、权限、Skill、MCP 与会话能力。 |

这些能力并不是彼此孤立的功能，而是由同一套协作架构连接起来：
src="docs/assets/readme/rovai-architecture.png"
alt="Rovai AI architecture showing Principal, Desktop, Core, Runtime Adapter Layer, Agent Runtimes, user workspace, and Runtime-native capabilities"
width="100%"

Agent Runtime 提供个体能力，Rovai 负责把它们组织成一支队伍。

设计理念

我们相信，队伍是这样长出来的
能力让队员加入队伍，共同经历才让他们彼此了解、彼此信赖。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
本次更新支持从侧栏导出完整会话，减少打开和切换会话时的查询开销，并修复执行状态显示和智能体收尾时的误判。
感谢 @caoshuisi 在 Issue #1012 中反馈 Pi 执行结束后被误判为失败，以及 CodeBuddy 报错原因不明确的问题。
-【功能】支持从侧栏导出完整会话。 在会话菜单选择「导出会话」，无需先滚动加载历史消息，即可预览并保存为 HTML、PNG 或 Markdown。需要导出片段时可多选消息，选中文字后的浮条仅提供引用。
-【界面】优化手机端的导出预览。 长按会话可打开导出菜单，HTML 预览随屏幕宽度排版，底部按钮更便于触控。
-【性能】减少打开和切换会话时对无关历史的扫描。 执行数量、执行列表和文件变更按当前会话读取。部分旧版执行卡片及其文件变更会从公屏的相应列表中移除，历史消息和原始记录仍保存在数据库中。
-【修复】重新执行后，消息回执会跟随最新状态。 执行失败或手动停止后再次执行，回执会随新一轮更新，「查看执行」也会打开新一轮的记录。同时修复没有投递或执行记录却误显示「待处理」的问题。
-【修复】修复智能体正常结束却被判为失败的问题。 Pi、Codex、Antigravity 及部分 ACP 智能体明确返回成功时，即使没有最后一条文字回复，执行也会正常结束。
-【修复】CodeBuddy 执行卡片会显示具体报错。 模型请求失败时，如果 CodeBuddy 返回了鉴权失败、请求参数有误等详情，可直接在执行卡片中查看。
-【交互】项目收起后再展开，从第一页显示会话。 普通项目、置顶项目和快速对话均先显示 5 条未置顶会话，可点击「查看更多」继续加载。
